trigger.name: prefresh_capture
trigger.match: feels less tired after your refreshment

trigger.name: sheal_capture
trigger.match: A warm feeling fills your body

muclient.script:
require 'aardwolf_colors'
pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0
function colorsToAnsiNote(data) return AnsiNote(ColoursToANSI(data)) end
function pheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) pheal = pheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]") end
function prefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) prefresh = prefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]") end
function sheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) sheal = sheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") end
function srefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) srefresh = srefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]") end
function pheal_trigger_end() if pheal > 0 then colorsToAnsiNote("@wYour party feels better after your healing. @G[@W" .. pheal .. "@G]") end
if prefresh > 0 then colorsToAnsiNote("@wYour party feels less tired after your refreshment. @C[@W" .. prefresh .. "@C]") end
if sheal > 0 then colorsToAnsiNote("@wA warm feeling fills your body. @G[@W" .. sheal .. "@G]") end
if srefresh > 0 then colorsToAnsiNote("@wYou feel less tired. @C[@W" .. srefresh .. "@C]") end
pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0 end
